A broken cannon fer clever
factory contraptions, with twelve slots picked
in turn. Use the screen
sliders to set throwin' force,
angle, stack size and time
between throws. Three stack-match slots beneath
the loot slots can trigger
it from within usin' AND
or OR logic. Combine that trigger
with the outside redstone trigger
by AND or OR as
well. The shutter opens early when
she's ready to throw and
waitin' on an outside signal.
All matchin' stacks fly out
together. Hover over a button fer
2s to read its orders.

Throwin' direction x/y (-45° to +45°)§r
§7Mind the green-red coordinate marks on the front.
Stack to throw (1 to 32 pieces o' loot)

Rules fer combinin' the outside signal§r
§9AND§7: Throw only when an outside signal arrives.
§9OR§7: Throw filter matches on their own; unmatched loot waits fer an outside trigger.
§9IGNORE§7: Pay no heed to outside redstone, as though its trigger were always on.

Rules fer combinin' the filters§r
§9AND§7: Throw the stacks named by the filters only when ALL filters show green.
§9OR§7: Throw each filter's stack when that filter shows green.

Outside redstone signal lookout
§7(click to trigger it by hand).

Triggerin' orders§r
§9Pulse§7: One throw each time the outside signal turns OFF->ON.
§9Continuous§7: Keep throwin' while the outside signal stays ON.

Throwin' speed (slow to swift)
§7The spring's held loose at the bottom and tight at the top.

A suckin' device fer clever factory
contraptions. She shifts half-stacks and gathers
over at most 9x9. Screen sliders
set gatherin' range (0 to 4),
wait between insertions (0.5s to 10s)
and stack size to insert (1
to 32). Redstone orders on screen:
ordinary or inverted (the startin' choice),
pulse or continuous (the startin' choice).
Stack to insert §7(1 to 32 pieces o' loot)

Waitin' lookout
§7Blinks while the insertion timer still runs, or when the suckin' device cannot stow loot in the next loot bag.

Sets blocks and plants crops or
trees. Screen redstone orders: ordinary
or inverted (the startin' choice), pulse
or continuous (the startin' choice).
Seeds go into clear space above

Outside signal §7(click fer one round o' block settin')

Stock row 2§r
§7Click to start settin' from the middle cargo row.

A plain wall built o' slag bricks.
Breaks the blocks in front o' its workin' face. Send a redstone signal to stop it. Its speed depends on the block ye've set it against.

A small pass-through oven in a
metal shell. She can draw loot
from the input side and stow
it in a loot bag at
the output side. Suckin' devices can
put in or take out loot
on any side. Anything ye can't
smelt or cook passes straight through.
A little swifter and thriftier with
power than a heated pebble oven.
FIFO queues and feeders shift whole
stacks; the feeders need a little
power. Put a suckin' device in
a spare slot to draw loot
from input-side storage on its own.

Spare support slot
§7Put a suckin' device here fer automatic feedin' from the input side.

Gathers fluid above it into
a tank holdin' three buckets.
She follows flowin' fluid
back to nearby source blocks.
Use fluid-transfer gear or a
bucket to take it out.
Gravity fills only tanks
below. Works with the ordinary
makin' o' endless water sources.

A frost-makin' contraption. She chills
water to frost, then tough
frost, then blue frost. Click
with a water bucket or
pipe water in, and keep
RF power aboard. Take out
the frost ye want with
a suckin' device or other
loot-removal gear. Cut the RF
supply or send a redstone
signal to stop her. A
redstone compaaratorrr tells yer automations
which frost stage be present.

A small metal-clad laboratory kiln with
an upward draught and solid fuel
to burn. Hotter and better insulated
than a pebble oven, so she
wastes less. Two spare slots can
hold yer stores. The input, output
and fuel each have an internal
suckin' FIFO queue holdin' two stacks.
Put an external heater in a
spare slot and supply power fer
an electric boost to smeltin' speed.

Milks cows now and then,
with a fluid tank aboard.
She won't feed yer cattle. Fetch
the milk with buckets. Milk
containers be drawn from or
stowed in storage behind or
below. She favours takin' from
behind and stowin' below, but can
return full vessels to the
same store. Fluid milk can
flow to tanks or pipes
below, provided milk exists as
a fluid. Don't crowd the cow
pen: contented beasts be the
ones that stroll past willingly.

A well-insulated electric rock melter
runnin' mighty hot.§r She heats mineral
blocks into magma blocks, then
molten rock. Click with a
mineral block, such as rock
or pebbles, or feed one in
with loot-insertion gear. Take the
molten rock with a bucket
or fluid extractor. Cool that
lava and ye get rock o'
tears. Cut RF power or
send redstone to stop the
oven. Use a redstone compaaratorrr
to tell yer automations which meltin'
stage the mineral has reached.

Makes a little power when
sunlight strikes it. Handy fer
fillin' LF capacitors in distant
rigs with a small appetite
fer power. Its charge-pump
circuit gathers RF and sends
it on often. Output depends
on the hour and the
weather. Click to see charge
aboard, power made and progress.
Fells grown trees in front o' its workin' face. She leaves the fallen loot fer ye to gather. Send redstone to stop her.

A rubbish bin with FIFO
slots aboard. Feed loot in
on any side; she keeps it
until the queue runs out
o' room. Then the oldest
stack meets the flames. Supply
electric RF/FE power to hurry the
work along. Her cargo stays
aboard when ye move her.

A plain gangway fer reachin' big
machines. Ye can also place it
from above in the direction ye
face. Click with a rail to
add a guardrail on one side: click
close fer exact placement, or from
afar fer the best fit. Click
again to take that rail away.

Click with a steel rail to add
or take away guardrails. Ye cannot place
it with its bottom face down. No
corner pieces here; these ain't ordinary stairs.

A gangway flush with the top
edge, joinin' steel poles below.
A stretch o' horizontal support beam fer a ceiling.

Steel floor finery, flush with the
top edge. Loose loot falls through.

A steel-framed window with three layers o'

come from the metal craftin' table progression.

A fence in factory style.
She won't join ordinary fences.
She joins full blocks when in
line with another mesh fence.

A factory-style gate to
match yer steel-mesh fence.
Place it at
single or double size.

A guardrail fer decoration. Hold
rails and click to add
or take away sides. It works
on steel service gangways too.
A stout steel table standin' on four legs.

A straight stretch o' fluid pipe.
Fluid travels only one way, with
no side joins and a slower
flow. Creep while placin' it to
turn the flow the other way.

A straight stretch o' fluid
pipe. Fluid travels only one way,
with no side joins. Creep
while placin' it to turn
the flow the other way. No
redstone power means no passage.

A straight stretch o' fluid pipe.
Fluid travels only one way,
with no side joins. Creep while
placin' it to turn the flow
the other way. No redstone
power means no passage. Flow is

A straight hollow pole

holdin' up yer structure.
Head or foot fer a thick steel pole

A steel fitting fer the head or

A straight hollow pole section (4x4x16)

Head or foot fer a thin steel pole

A steel fitting fer the head or

A straight pole section as

A timber fitting fer the head

A target that sends
a redstone pulse into its
support block when struck
by an arrow or worked
by hand. Click with
a redstone torch to
choose the output, cyclin' through
this switch's supported orders.

A player lookout ye mount on
a wall above a door.§r

Points up, down or
both ways, accordin' to
where ye click the wall
while placin' it. A
switch that sends a
short redstone signal, like
a button. Click with
a redstone torch to choose
the output, cyclin' through
this switch's supported orders.

A switch that sends
a short redstone signal, like
a button. Click with
a redstone torch to choose
the output, cyclin' through
this switch's supported orders. Work
it again while it's
active to stretch the
pulse. Left-click with a redstone
stack to fix a
pulse length between 0.1s (1)
and 6.4s (64). Left-click
with any dye to give
the switch a colour.

A glass floor plate that
changes colour and sends redstone
when pressed from above,
as when a matey stands
on it, and fer a
short while after the pressure's
gone. Outputs face the front
and bottom. She makes no
sound and her sensors be
mighty sensitive. Click with
a redstone torch to choose
the output, cyclin' through this
switch's supported orders. Left-click with
a redstone stack to set
the hold time between
0.1s (1) and 6.4s (64).
Left-click with any dye to
give the switch a colour.

A small glass contraption that
sends redstone from yer
chosen start hour to yer
chosen end hour. Buttons on
the front set the
span in 24-hour time, with
06:00 markin' sunrise. They also
set output strength and
a random delay. That last
setting holds back switchin' on
or off fer a
random span, longer at higher
values. Output goes to the
support block, and she
makes no switchin' noise. Click
with a redstone torch to
choose the output, cyclin'
through this switch's supported orders.
Glass contact plate under yer orders

A glass deck plate that
changes colour and sends redstone
when weight presses on her
top, such as a matey
standin' there. She keeps the
signal a short while
after the pressure lifts. Output
goes forwards and below, with
no sound. Use the touch
controls' up/down buttons to set
output strength, the entity filter,
how many entities and sensitivity.
Click with a redstone torch
to choose the output, cyclin'
through this switch's supported orders.
Left-click with a stack
o' redstone to set how
long she holds, from 0.1s
(1) to 6.4s (64). Left-click
with any dye to give
the switch yer chosen colour.

A little glass contraption
watchin' a set space, sendin'
redstone when she spots
an entity. She watches
two blocks above and below,
and her chosen range
ahead, left and right,
coverin' 180 degrees. Small front
buttons set that range,
output strength, how many
entities she must see
and their kind: mobs, sailors,
beasts and the like.
Output goes to her
support block. She switches without
a sound. Click with
a redstone torch to
choose the output, cyclin' through
this switch's supported orders.

Emergency medical tool. It can be used manually, and it can auto-trigger at low health to grant short survival effects before entering cooldown.
